Subject: Greenleaf security discovery — SOC 2 status & isolation next steps

Hi Asha — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can capture requirements and scope for a Private deployment (VPC/on‑prem/air‑gapped).

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Primary concerns: data residency (US), HIPAA handling for PHI, and network isolation for inference nodes.
- Target environment: Greenleaf prefers VPC first; open to air‑gapped on-prem for pilot if needed.
- Expected timing: procurement window Q2; security review must complete before SOW.

Action items we discussed:
1) Please confirm SOC 2 status (Type I/II, and date of last audit).
2) Share your vendor RFI (we can map responses to your controls).
3) Network diagram: a simple sketch of the target topology (subnets, NAT/egress points) will help us recommend isolation patterns and caching strategies.
4) We attached a short SOC2 summary for Redwood and a vendor questionnaire template to speed review.

Attachments: [redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)], [redwood_vendor_q_template.xlsx (Excel, 45 KB)].

Proposed next step: 30‑minute follow up on Thu Jan 12 at 10:00 AM PST to go over the RFI and confirm which controls are highest priority. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward.

—

Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenleaf security discovery — SOC 2 status & isolation next steps

Stephanie — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and attached RFI + topology sketch.

SOC 2: we are currently SOC 2 Type II in progress; fieldwork completed Dec 2027, final report expected mid‑Q2 2028. We can provide interim evidence and our SOC 2 control matrix (redacted) while the final report is in flight.

HIPAA/GDPR: Greenleaf processes PHI for US patients only; HIPAA controls apply. We also have GDPR considerations for EU originated records, though volume is minimal. Data retention and deletion workflows are high priority.

Attached: Greenleaf_Vendor_RFI.pdf (PDF, 234 KB) — contains our RFI and a starter network isolation sketch (network‑isolation-sketch.png). Please review and mark which items Redwood can answer directly vs. requires engineering input.

A few clarifying questions for Redwood:
- Can Redwood provide a network‑level isolation diagram for a minimal VPC deployment and an alternate air‑gapped on‑prem sketch?
- Do you support running inference nodes with no internet egress and only controlled ops channels (jump host / offline updates)?
- What evidence can you provide for encryption at rest keys (KMS/HSM integrations)?

We'll fill the RFI and return with our priority controls by EOD Jan 13. The Jan 12 slot doesn't work on our side — can we move the follow up to Mon Jan 15 at 9:00 AM PST?

Attachments: [Greenleaf_Vendor_RFI.pdf], [network-isolation-sketch.png].

Best,
Asha Patel
Director, Information Security
Greenleaf Health
asha.patel@greenleafhealth.com
